notes.title: First patch is here!
notes.notes:
Hey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372911/8c95dbccffe69793db82d6ae4aff06998a15d866.png[/img]

With your help, we found and fixed several bugs.
One of them was big and scary - it made the game impassable.
Thank you for helping to find and fix it!

Additionally fixed several visual problems.

notes.title: The game has been released!!
notes.notes:
Ooh! Whoo! Aah! Humans! We released!!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372911/89b4cf2245fb194efb35c5083da961a889a37d0d.png[/img]
Panic running in a circle... climbing under the skirting board... ...looking around...
We're very scared and very interested at the same time!
God, we love quests, we hope you like them too! =)
Thanks to everyone who supported us throughout the development process - it was very important for us!

YOU'RE PURREAUTIFUL!

notes.title: The release of Episode 1 will take place on April 01, 2020 at STEAM.
notes.notes:
Hello Humans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372911/e836856d69f2209c1560225e1da67be8b09b6310.png[/img]

Humorous 2D point-and-click adventure Mad Cat's World about cat and vegan, ready for release! YOO-HOO! 
The release of Episode 1 will take place on April 01, 2020 at STEAM.
This is our first project, we hope you like it! =)

A DEMO version of the game is already available on STEAM (~15 minutes game time).

notes.title: Demo version is now available.
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Humans![/b]
